programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game Presented by Baccarat Crystal 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: Big pots and bigger bluffs in Las Vegas, Nevada as more WPT high-stakes cash game action is coming your way.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game Presented by Baccarat Crystal 2021 - Part 2

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game Presented by Baccarat Crystal 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: The cards are in the air in Las Vegas, Nevada as the World Poker Tour presents more high-stakes cash game action.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game Presented by Baccarat Crystal 2021 - Part 3

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game Presented by Baccarat Crystal 2021 - Part 4
programme.desc: WPT high-stakes cash is wrapping up in Las Vegas, Nevada, but not before some more huge pots are won and lost.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game Presented by Baccarat Crystal 2021 - Part 4

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Gardens Poker Championship 2021 - Part 1
programme.desc: Season 18 is underway in Las Vegas, as six remaining players take their seats for a shot at over half a million dollars.

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Gardens Poker Championship 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: There are four remaining in the fight for over $500,000. Chance Kornuth is looking to add another huge cash to his tournament poker resume but is trailing the new chip leader, Tuan Phan, by only a small margin.

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Gardens Poker Championship 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: As we approach a dramatic finish to the Gardens Casino WPT Main Event, the tides have turned.

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Borgata 2021 - Part 1
programme.desc: Six remaining players square off on the felt of the WPT Borgata Final Table where one player will be crowned a WPT Champion and receive over $600,000.

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Borgata 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: The action continues at WPT Borgata. After the final table's first elimination, five remaining players inch closer and closer to a WPT trophy.

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Borgata 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: Veerab Zakarian leads the way of the three remaining at the WPT Borgata final table. Can he hang on to secure the title of WPT Champion or will one of the shorter stacks find a way to battle back?

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT L.A. Poker Classic 2021 - Part 1
programme.desc: Another name will be added to the Mike Sexton WPT Champions Cup after the conclusion of the WPT L.A. Poker Classic Main Event, but first, a winner must be decided.

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT L.A. Poker Classic 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: Bala Patur leads the way, but former WPT Champion Matas Cimbolas is heating up and is now only behind by a small margin.

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT L.A. Poker Classic 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: We are down to four players at the final table of the WPT L.A. Poker Classic. WPT Champion Matas Cimbolas, who finished second in this event in 2019, is still in the hunt for the title.

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Seminole Hard Rock Showdown 2021 - Part 1
programme.desc: WPT hits Hollywood, FL to host the Seminole Hard Rock Poker Showdown. This tournament drew a field of 2,482 entrants marking the largest field of any WPT event.
programme.sub-title: WPT Seminole Hard Rock Showdown 2021 - Part 1

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Seminole Hard Rock Showdown 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: Sonny Franco has maintained the chip lead at this final table, but seasoned pro Brek Schutten is right on his heels.
programme.sub-title: WPT Seminole Hard Rock Showdown 2021 - Part 2

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Seminole Hard Rock Showdown 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: It's crunch time in Hollywood, Florida as only one of three remaining players can be crowned champion receiving over $1 million and have their name forever engraved in the Mike Sexton WPT Champions Cup.
programme.sub-title: WPT Seminole Hard Rock Showdown 2021 - Part 3

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game $200/$400 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 1
programme.desc: WPT High stakes cash is back as season 19 kicks off with a bang. Over 1 million dollars is on the table and several big-name pros are sitting down including WPT Champions Justin Young and Seth Davies.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game $200/$400 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 1

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game $200/$400 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 2
programme.desc: Ali Imisiriovic is no stranger to high-stakes cash and he is enjoying his time in Las Vegas playing for pots worth thousands.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game $200/$400 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 2

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game $200/$400 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 3
programme.desc: More high-stakes action in Las Vegas with pros running huge bluffs for tons of cash.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game $200/$400 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 3

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game $200/$400 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 4
programme.desc: Renowned tournament and cash game player Chris Brewer joins the table with plans of winning thousands.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game $200/$400 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 4

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipfighter Hunder av Krig
programme.desc: Mannskapet oppdager at en falsk planet, Marduk, har skapt masseødeleggelsesvåpen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lepras kyss
programme.desc: En hitman med navnet Leper er rettet mot lederne for det nye samveldet.

programme.title: Andromeda: For hvem bjelleveiene
programme.desc: Andromeda hjemsøkes av en mystisk skapning som kommer ombord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: Og ditt hjerte vil fly bort
programme.desc: Når en forlengst mistet kjærlighet kommer tilbake, forsvinner Tyr fra skipet for å beskytte henne mot en snikmorder.
programme.sub-title: Og ditt hjerte vil fly bort

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ukontrable mannen
programme.desc: Sett i et alternativt univers der Dylan døde og Gaheris Rhade prøver å reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Gruppen som angrep Andromeda under den første undertegningen av Commonwealth-charteret, vender tilbake til mer kaos.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Dark Backward
programme.desc: Trance går gjennom noen forskjellige scenarier og prøver å finne en der mannskapet hennes ikke dør.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Risk-All Point
programme.desc: Et kraftigere Andromeda-skip eksploderer på grunn av sannsynlig sabotasje, og tvinger Dylans mannskap til å redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rette hesten
programme.desc: Beka setter både mannskapet og en hel planet i fare når en tidligere kjærlighet dukker opp.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hva skjer med en revidert utsatt?
programme.desc: Andromeda mottar et rop om hjelp fra pastor Bam.
programme.sub-title: Hva skjer med en revidert utsatt?

programme.title: Andromeda: Spydspunktet
programme.desc: Etter at en Commonwealth-planet er angrepet av pyriske pyroformere, blir Dylan tvunget til å kjempe for å beskytte den nye planeten.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himmelhvelvet
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer som tilsier ham til en planet med 'ild og is'.

programme.title: Andromeda: Deep Midnight's Voice
programme.desc: Mens han er fanget i en kamp mellom to Nietzschean-stolthetspunkter, fanger mannskapet en fiendtlig som hevder at stoltheten hans har et kart over slipstream.

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusjonen av majestet
programme.desc: En feil sving etter å ha gått ut av en slipstream sender Andromeda inn i Prolon-systemet. De redder en fluktpute fra en viss katastrofe, men stoltheten vil ha den tilbake.

programme.title: Andromeda: Twilight of the Idols
programme.desc: Mannskapet søker en tapt koloni av Nietzscheans og oppdager et annet mannskap som i det skjulte har hjulpet dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dommens dag, Vredens dag
programme.desc: Mannskapet installerer en ny AI i et nytt Commonwealth-slagskip, og naturlig nok går ikke ting som de skal.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skygger kastet av en siste hilsen
programme.desc: Tyr overbeviser Nietzscheans at han er reinkarnasjonen til Drago Museveni.
programme.sub-title: Skygger kastet av en siste hilsen

programme.title: Andromeda: Svar gitt på spørsmål som aldri er stilt
programme.desc: En melding fra en samler sender Dylan på et oppdrag for å redde et gissel og finne restene av Commonwealth-flåten.
programme.sub-title: Svar gitt på spørsmål som aldri er stilt

programme.title: Andromeda: Biter av åtte
programme.desc: Citizen Eight prøver å fjerne Dylan fra kommandoen over Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Waking the Tyrant's Device
programme.desc: Mannskapet må stoppe en verdensbygger før han setter i gang en annen invasjon.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dobbelt eller ingenting
programme.desc: Dylan blir kidnappet av Nietzscheans og tvunget til å spille tankespill til underholdning for fangene hans.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Betrayed
programme.desc: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting: The Identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Critical Evidence
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Buried inside the Bombing Decoy
programme.desc: A Second World War bombing decoy site at Formby. It was commissioned in December 1940 as a 'Permanent Starfish' site to deflect enemy bombing from the city of Liverpool and it is now home to a whole host of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Fun and Games at The Sportsman Inn
programme.desc: Bex, Sean and Paul, investigate claims of paranormal incidents inside of a haunted inn. Once three separate cottages, will any of the previous residents join the investigation tonight? Or is there something more sinister haunting here?
programme.sub-title: Fun and Games at The Sportsman Inn

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: A Poltergeist Nightmare at 30 East Drive
programme.desc: The team step into a house that has become a legend with the paranormal community, 30 East Drive, Pontefract.
programme.sub-title: A Poltergeist Nightmare at 30 East Drive

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: The Club
programme.desc: One haunted members only club and a bar full if spirits. Ghost Dimension capture ghostly goings on, inside of Aintree Conservative Club. A place never investigated before and has paranormal activity daily.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: House of Fear
programme.desc: Located in Gran Canaria, there is one house that locals refuse to enter and that is, The House of Fear. Ghostly shadows, loud banging and demonic voices have all been reported here and the Ghost Dimension team will investigate these claims tonight.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Last Orders at The Fleece Inn
programme.desc: The team heads to Elland to investigate ghostly-goings on in this haunted pub. It's not just the spirits behind the bar lurking here. Multiple hauntings, murders and death surround this public house.
programme.sub-title: Last Orders at The Fleece Inn

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Souls Seeking Solace Gotts Park Mansion
programme.desc: The team encounters a spirit member joining them on the thermal imaging camera and appearing to leave its ghostly hand print behind.
programme.sub-title: Souls Seeking Solace Gotts Park Mansion

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Underground World Of The City of Caves
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team ventures underground to investigate the City of Caves in Nottingham.
programme.sub-title: Underground World Of The City of Caves

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Dangerous Demon of The Stork Inn
programme.desc: Sean heads to Wigan to investigate a location with history dating back to 900AD. Encountering a spirit that attacks him, will the team be safe tonight as they come face to face with pure evil?
programme.sub-title: Dangerous Demon of The Stork Inn

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Buried Beneath The Bowling Green
programme.desc: Buried under the location Sean investigates tonight, is the bones of the deceased and it appears that they are at unrest. Will Sean solve the mystery of who is haunting this location?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Demons on The Buses
programme.desc: Hidden in St Helens, is a museum that is home to demonic and dark entities trapped inside of vehicles.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Not a Very Fun Day at The Beech Caves
programme.desc: Witchcraft, demons and ghosts have all been reported to haunt these caves. Sean investigates this network of tunnels deep underground and uncovers that all is not as it seems. This is not a day out at the seaside at Beech Caves.
programme.sub-title: Not a Very Fun Day at The Beech Caves

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Ghosts of The Asylum
programme.desc: Paul and Sean visit one very haunted Asylum in Manchester and come to face with ghostly souls that are haunting the building. The Asylum housed the criminally insane and it would appear, as the building closed, some of them never left!

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads deep into the Pendle Hills in search of the Pendle Witches that went to trial in 1612 and were hung for witchcraft. The investigation takes an unexpected twist with a stop at the New Inn, Pendles most haunted pub.
programme.sub-title: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 2
programme.desc: Sean continues his investigation of Pendle Hill and ventures even deeper into the hills. The night takes an unexpected turn with a dramatic ending, which he believes was caused by the witches.
programme.sub-title: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to the town of Morley to investigate the infamous Morley Market. A place once bustling with people from years gone by, it is now haunted by shadow figures, and they appear to want to make themselves known.
programme.sub-title: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 2
programme.desc: Sean continues the investigation at Morley Market and appears to be followed by a spirit person that wants to touch him and distract him from investigating certain parts of the main hall. Will he uncover who this spirit is?
programme.sub-title: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 1
programme.desc: Four floors of terror! Objects from around the world are at home in the museum, but what is attached to them, which now roams the floors and corridors after dark?
programme.sub-title: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 2
programme.desc: With activity sending the team into a spin on the top floor, is there something attached to the museum's main attraction, the mummy?
programme.sub-title: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 2

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Do I Have a Child With a Gay Man?
programme.desc: Are Tracy and Latonia's men leading secret double lives with other men? What will the lie detector test results reveal about Kanecha and Mike?
programme.sub-title: Do I Have a Child With a Gay Man?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: DNA Shockers
programme.desc: Monique and Ashley find out who their newborn babies' fathers are on today's Steve Wilkos Show!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: This Should Be Explosive...
programme.desc: Katrina believes her sister Kendra’s boyfriend is a cheater and having sex with her best friend Nay-Nay! Later, John returns to the stage with a shocking update!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Do You Need a Medic or Are You Guilty?
programme.desc: Michelle needs answers about who hurt her daughter. She will stop at nothing to protect her baby. Will the father James clear his name on Steve's stage?
programme.sub-title: Do You Need a Medic or Are You Guilty?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: DNA: Don't Run From the Results
programme.desc: Roberta suspects that her husband Bryan has been cheating. They both believe the other is cheating. Find out whether these men are really the father on today's Steve Wilkos!
programme.sub-title: DNA: Don't Run From the Results

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: He Said Give Your Baby Away and You Did
programme.desc: Shannan claims Tim fathered her child. He doesn't buy it because he doesn't recall having sex with her! Later, Ayana is furious that her boyfriend Patrick denies their son!
programme.sub-title: He Said Give Your Baby Away and You Did

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This
programme.desc: Is Khadisa's boyfriend Chad cheating on her with her own sister? Will Maya's ex trust her and her current beau with their infant son?
programme.sub-title: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Your Kids Need Their Mom, But You Chose Him
programme.desc: Will Nadia and Woody's lie detector test results prove that they were negligent and deserved to lose custody of their children? Then, can Steve set the record straight about Josette's daughter?
programme.sub-title: Your Kids Need Their Mom, But You Chose Him

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: The 1,000th Episode!
programme.desc: On the 1,000th episode, we'll bring you all of the crazy confessions, explosive meltdowns, chair throws, funny moments and the heartfelt stories that have made this show special!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Saw Right Through You
programme.desc: Today on Steve Wilkos, Maurice wants to prove to his girlfriend that he's faithful. Plus Chuanhtee says fed up with Ladi's cheating accusations! Watch as the truth is revealed!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Have Two Husbands
programme.desc: Jessica married Gian after a five-month relationship. With a baby on the way, everything seems to be going great for the couple, except Jessica is married to another man, Michael!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: An Explosive DNA Story
programme.desc: Teneal and Richard are telling different tales, each alleging the other is unfit to parent! The truth will come down to a lie detector test, and the results will be shocking!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, I Can't Face The Truth.
programme.desc: Today Danny is finally ready to face the missing man in his life and get answers to lifelong questions. Steven offers a number of excuses for not seeing his son, but can he redeem himself?
programme.sub-title: Steve, I Can't Face The Truth.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Murder My Daughter?
programme.desc: Two years ago, Latisha and her boyfriend were found shot to death in their car. Latisha’s mother Nancy believes her ex-husband Kenneth was involved. Who is responsible for their deaths?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Got a 14 Year Old Pregnant
programme.desc: Megan is 14 and pregnant with 19 year old Michael’s baby, but he doesn’t see any problems with this situation. Laurie, Megan’s mother, turns to Steve to help get through to her!
programme.sub-title: I Got a 14 Year Old Pregnant

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, Get Him Out!
programme.desc: Kelly’s ex-husband Nikki continues to haunt her. He went to jail for killing her 2 week old son and is now dating her 18 year old daughter! Can Steve get Nikki out of their lives forever?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Mother in Denial
programme.desc: When ordinary people need help, Steve Wilkos is ready to answer the call. Watch as Steve helps ordinary people stand up for themselves and fight for what he believes in order to promote justice for all.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Mother's Rage
programme.desc: Three years later, Elizabeth still carries strong doubts about Manny's intentions with her family and her husband Rodney is caught in the middle. Is Manny innocent?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Mommy Hurt Me
programme.desc: Stephanie’s drug addiction led her to neglect and abuse her kids. Scott’s fiancée stepped up as a mother and Stephanie failed multiple drug tests, he doesn’t want her near the kids, but wants her to atone for her wrongs!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who’s Hurting My Granddaughter?
programme.desc: Maria claims that her son’s ex Amy and her new boyfriend Brian are abusing and neglecting her granddaughter. But Amy says Maria is a racist and angry over raising her grandchild in a Hispanic home!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: What Happened to My Baby?
programme.desc: Baby Garrett died of an oxycodone drug overdose while in Sharon’s care. His mother Casey left him with Sharon so she could visit her husband Kenneth in the hospital. Who’s responsible?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Wait! Don't Read The Results Yet Steve...
programme.desc: Sharina thinks that Clarence is cheating on her because he’s always out late. Plus, Chrystal doesn’t want Earnie’s ex Tenyia to live with them just because she’s the mother of his child.
programme.sub-title: Wait! Don't Read The Results Yet Steve...

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Case That Haunts Me
programme.desc: As Det. Joe Kenda digs into another murder, he uncovers a world of violence and sexual fetishes, culminating in perhaps the most intense interrogation of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: We Kill the Ones We Love
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves Van Terry dead; to crack the case, Lt. Joe Kenda must put his faith… in a burglar.
programme.sub-title: We Kill the Ones We Love

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Nine-Year-Old Hostage
programme.desc: A hostage situation puts Sgt. Joe Kenda and his team to the test, as they try to save a family without getting shot themselves.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Door No. 12
programme.desc: Neighbors are stunned when close friends Louis Matos and Colleen Johnson are gunned down for no apparent reason. The case kicks into high gear when Lt Joe Kenda locates a panic-stricken eyewitness.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Powder Kegs
programme.desc: When uninvited guests crash a barrio birthday party, violence erupts—leaving Enrique Urrutia dead and potentially sparking a gang war.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Confession
programme.desc: After a husband and wife are viciously attacked in their own home, Kenda is on the hunt for a troubled teen whose appetite for violence knows no bounds.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Joker In the Pack
programme.desc: A card game is interrupted by gunfire, leaving a young man dead. Lt. Joe Kenda soon learns the seeds of his destruction were sewn earlier the same day.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Time Bomb
programme.desc: In 1978, Lt. Joe Kenda is new to the CSPD, and gets more than he bargains for when a local bank is the target of a massive explosion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Too Young To Die
programme.desc: A frenzied ambush at a hamburger stand leaves a 16-year old boy dead. Lt. Joe Kenda must cut through a mountain of rumor and innuendo in order to zero in on his prime suspect.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Haunts Me
programme.desc: A young mother-to-be is shot and left for dead. To catch her assailant, Kenda must elicit a death-bed confession from the victim herself.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Razor’s Edge
programme.desc: When police find 24-year-old Patrick Ray with a gunshot to the temple, the scene has all the telltale signs of suicide. But Lt. Joe Kenda's instinct says otherwise.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Manifesto
programme.desc: A cabin on the slopes of Pikes Peak catches fire, and a young sheriff’s deputy is posted to guard the scene overnight--then he’s found dead in his patrol car the next morning.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Shoelace Killer
programme.desc: A party on the outskirts of the city turns into a nightmare for some teenagers when they discover a woman’s corpse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bring My Baby Home
programme.desc: A four-week-old girl is kidnapped, leaving her mother in anguish and police scrambling to find her. Joe Kenda and Robert Sapp fear she’s been sold on the black market… or worse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Weapon of Choice
programme.desc: When mother of two Shaundra Murr is run over in front of her house, officers initially suspect a hit and run. Until Lt. Joe Kenda uncovers evidence proving Shaundra’s murder was a crime of passion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Slaughterhouse Six
programme.desc: Solider and young father Layne Schmidtke is brutally beaten to death by a mob of teenagers. Kenda must reconstruct the chaotic scene through forensic evidence and witness testimonies.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Call for Murder
programme.desc: Five people are shot in a cold-blooded robbery. With much of the evidence lost in a fire set by the suspect. An exhaustive manhunt ends in a chilling confrontation with an Eagle Scout turned killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bullet With My Name On It
programme.desc: In his first year on the force, rookie patrol officer Joe Kenda quickly learns the ropes. But when he tries to singlehandedly stop a brawling mob, he finds himself facing down gunfire.
programme.sub-title: Bullet With My Name On It

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Når jentene krasjer guttenes Hawaii tur, prøver Valeria å glemme Justin ved å flørte med Brordy. Heidis ekskjæreste, som er jomfru, kommer på besøk og Heidi håper at Spenser skal lære noe av eksens verdier.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrina fortviler når Brodys kjæreste konfronterer henne med Hawaii, og Brody gjør ingenting for å stoppe det. Heidi oppdager en tekstmelding fra Stacie til Spencer og drar til nattklubben for å konfrontere henne med det.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren er usikker på om hun skal gå i Heidis bryllup etter at Spencer endelig har bedt om unnskyldning. Brody nekter å risikere forholdet sitt til Jayde for å redde vennskapet med Audrina, og Stephanie konfronterer Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens siste episode må hun bestemme om hun er villig til å tilgi Spencer for å kunne stille opp for Heidi i hennes "prinsesse"-bryllup. Hele besetningen dukker opp og blir overrasket over en gjest ingen tenkte ville komme.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin starter krig når hun forsøker seg på Justin foran Audrina. Spencer og Heidi leter etter hus, og Spencer kjøper et hus uten Heidis godkjennelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Etter at Audrina ikke dukket opp, bestemmer Kristin seg for ikke å kjempe mot sine følelser for Justin. Heidi melder seg som barnevakt for naboen, men Spencer vil ikke ha noe med unger å gjøre.
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får smake på hvordan det er å ha et forhold til Justin når han ikke dukker opp på Brodys overraskelsesfest. Heidi og Spencer er uenige om når de skal starte familie, og Audrina dater Justins bestevenn.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror hun har temmet Justin, men kanskje er han fortsatt ikke over Audrina. Når Holly mister kontrollen på en tilstelning, er det Heidis jobb å få søsteren til å innrømme alkoholproblemet sitt.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin gjør seg kostbar med Kristin, men biter seg i halen. Hollys drikking fører til at Heidi og Stephanie må gripe inn. Brody og Jayde krangler slik at de må revurdere forholdet sitt.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin går på glør etter at Kristin og Audrina endelig møtes ansikt til ansikt. Alt Heidi ønsker seg til bursdag er en baby, men Spencer har helt andre planer.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin og Brody vurderer å date igjen, men når de støter på Jayde forstår de at tiden ikke er moden. Audrina og Justin møtes for å diskutere framtiden, men det ender ikke som hun håpet. Spencer går drastisk til verks mot Heidis babybesettelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin støter sammen med Jayde når hun kommer for å gjenerobre Brody. Heidi legger en plan for å bli gravid med eller uten Spencers samtykke, og Audrina må takle at Justin fortsatt har følelser for Kristin.
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vil ikke ha Justin, men han gir henne ikke opp så lett. Audrina avslutter forholdet til Justin for godt. Brody får kalde føtter når Jayde vil flytte inn hos ham, og Spencer frykter at Heidi muligens kan være gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin og Justin vil gå videre med forholdet, og Spencer konfronterer Heidi med graviditetstesten. Brody har kanskje fortsatt følelser for Kristin etter at Jayde konfronterer ham med tilstanden til deres forhold på en forlovelsesfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Heidis hjemkomst blir ødelagt når moren hennes misliker hennes plastisk kirurgi. Kristin og jentene drar til Miami for Super Bowl-helgen, men det blir dårlig stemning når den harde festingen hennes begynner å bekymre Audrina, Lo og Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: Når ryktene begynner å spres om Kristins festing, får Stephanie skylden. Audrina starter å date en ny fyr, men det stopper ikke Brody fra å prøve seg på henne. Spencer blir opprørt når han møter på Stephanie på Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi arrangerer en fest for naboen hennes, men det blir overskygget av at Spencer blir sint på Holly. Kristin oppfordrer Audrina til å forplikte seg til Ryan, og prøver deretter å komme nærmere Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencers oppførsel fører til at deres venner og familie tar et vanskelig valg. Kristin og Brody roter, men er enige om å fortsette som single. Ryan skuffer Audrina når han ikke dukker opp for en kveld på byen.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody risikerer sitt vennskap med Kristin når han begynner å date ei annen jente. Lo setter Stephanie opp på en dobbeldate. Ryan gir Audrinas venner en ny sjanse.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin sliter med å gå videre etter Brody. Audrina møter på Justin og begynner å tvile på sitt forhold til Ryan. Lo blir venn med Brodys nye kjæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nye flamme gjør en fiende av Kristin når hun tar med seg en gammel rival av Kristins på en fest. Ryan kommer tilbake fra turneen, men Audrina forteller ham ikke at hun møtte Justin mens han var borte.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas forhold til Ryan blir satt på prøve når han møter Justin for første gang. Brody er på Kristins side når Allie krangler med henne. Stephanie har en skuffende andre date.
programme.sub-title: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: Akkurat da Audrina avslutter ting med Ryan, overrasker Justin henne på bursdagen hennes. McKaelas venn Allie lager mer trøbbel med Kristin. Brody forteller Justin hva han tenker.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: På en surfetur til Costa Rica, gjør Kristin Brody sjalu ved å rote med en lokal bartender, Audrina prøver å bekjempe hennes tiltrekning til Justin, og Stephanie finner seg selv på kant med jungelmiljøet.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin har en åpenthjertig samtale med Brody, hun ønsker å gi forholdet en ny sjanse. Heidis mor kommer til LA, i håp om å forsone seg med henne. Lo og kjæresten hennes feirer sitt jubileum, og Stephanie begynner å date en ny.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står overfor en stor avgjørelse som også påvirker Brody. Audrina slår opp med Justin. Lo vet ikke om hun er klar til å ta neste skritt med hennes kjæreste og Stephanie mener hun har endelig funnet sann lykke.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: Det er en ny begynnelse for den ikoniske vennegruppen da de kommer tilbake til The Hills og tar opp kontakten etter mange år. Nye utfordringer, gamle feider og romanser kolliderer. Fortiden er nemlig ikke alltid i fortiden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie forsøker å reparere forholdet til boren, Spencer. Mischa treffer Perez Hilton, som mobbet henne da hun var skuespiller. Gnisten mellom Audrina og Justin fortsetter å ulme, men Justin kan ha fått øye for noen annen også.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får sjokkerende informasjon om Justin Bobby, og tvinges til å etterprøve motivene hans. Sinnene koker når Spencer og Heidi stiller spørsmålstegn ved sitt forhold til Brody. Brandon Thomas Lee arrangere en bassengfest hos sin mor.
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterer Justin med at han nektet å ha kysset henne. Brody klager over forholdet til faren, til Caitlyn, og sin forhenværende bestevenn, Spencer. Spencer og Heidis forhold settes på prøve når de kjemper med å få firmaet til å vokse.
programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Gjengen drar til Vegas for å se Brodys DJ-forestilling. Justin finner seg plutselig midt i en konfrontasjon mellom Audrina og Stephanie. Storbrann herjer gjennom Malibu, og Kaitlynn frykter for Brodys liv når han blir værende i evakueringssonen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn håndterer det ødeleggende etterspillet av Malibu-brannene. Audrina fatter et vanskelig valg om Justin. Samtidig har Mischa en prøvespilling med høy innsats for en filmrolle. Heidi begynner å gjenopplive popstjerne karrieren.
programme.sub-title: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Enemy #1
programme.desc: Sladderen tar fyr og ryktene går etter en skandaløs hendelse med Brody og Stephanie. Audrina blir sjokkert da Justin tar med en hakesleppende date til middagen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Are We Exclusive?
programme.desc: Kaitlynn & Brody's 'A-liste'-galla splitter gruppen når hun ekskluderer deler av gjengen. Audrina overrasker alle med en nytenning av en lidenskapelig romanse med en gammel flamme. Spencer forbløffer Heidi med en overdådig overraskelse.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Messages From Home
programme.desc: Daisy håper at en nykommer kan vise seg å være hennes prins. Bobby får igjen følelser for Rhianne, og en "eks-tra" kraft bringer 'hjemmet' til villaen for første gang noensinne!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bayley's Home Truths
programme.desc: Alex får sjansen på romantikk med nye, gale Dominika. Natalee og Matty finner hverandre, og en sjokkerende nykommer kan bety slutten for George og Bayley.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Day Of The Dead Finale
programme.desc: Finalefesten holdes på De dødes dag. Kan de opprinnelige jentene forlate villaen som venner? Vil noen av parene overleve? Eller vil en siste nykommer skape tidenes største kaos i villaen?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Episode 1
programme.desc: Ti singler treffes på stranden, men en sjokkerende ankomst gjør at to ekser gjenforenes fysisk for første gang. Blir det kjærlighet ved første blikk eller total kollisjon?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Second Chances
programme.desc: Wendale vil ha svar fra sin 'Den som slapp unna', Emily; Charlies anfører, begynner å endre seg og stranden byr på nok en eks som er desperat etter å forsones.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Romance And Revelations
programme.desc: Skrekkbrettet sjokkerer huset ved å avsløre et hemmelig stevnemøte. Romantikken ligger i luften for Grant, og slaget om Nads begynner.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: THE ONE THAT GOT AWAY GETAWAY!
programme.desc: 'De som slapp unna'-eksparene sendes på en avgjørende romantisk flukt, men fører det dem sammen eller slutter alt i tårer?
programme.sub-title: THE ONE THAT GOT AWAY GETAWAY!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Temptation, Tears and Tantrums
programme.desc: I en sjokkerende eliminasjon blir et av 'De som slapp unna'-parene sendt hjem. Et nytt bombenedslag ryster huset og en sint eks vaskes opp uten hensikt å forsones.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Charming Charlie
programme.desc: Klarer Charlie å sjarmere seg vekk fra to sinte ekser (og Nads) dårlige bøker? Chloes usikkerhet tar overhånd og tres tid i huset trues.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: If Looks Could Kill
programme.desc: Huset må håndtere en sjokkerende trippel avreise. Nads og Charlie kan gå mot katastrofe. Jay og Tasha blir bedre kjent. Chloe endrer innstilling til Ozzie, men er det for lite og for sent?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Chloe hopper fra èn kjærlighetstriangel til den andre. Nadia får en hyggelig overraskelse. En eksplosiv dobbel utstemming presser et par til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Shake Ups & Break Ups!
programme.desc: Ozzies kjærlighetstriangel slutter dramatisk. En rar ulykke sjokkerer huset. Charlie må fatte en enorm avgjørelse.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: He Loves Me, He Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Huset rystes av en sjokkerende OG-avreise. Kan Charlie sjarmere seg ut av mer trøbbel? En følelsesmessig finale gir uventet hjertesorg.
programme.sub-title: He Loves Me, He Loves Me Not

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Journey To Engagement
programme.desc: Seks par og eksene deres må bestemme om de skal fri eller gå hver for seg. Men før de svarer ja, kan de komme over eksene?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You're Breaking My Heart
programme.desc: Parene installerer seg i huset, men ferien er over da de første eksene sjekker inn. Liam får vite den hjerteskjærende sannheten om Leylah og eksen. Det første Hemmelighullet avslører noen tankevekkende sannheter og overraskende gjester.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Secrets Of The Past
programme.desc: Hemmelighullet ønsker flere ekser velkomne, noe som truer parenes tid i paradis. Sorinn og Lola har en eksplosiv krangel til middag. En eks' ankomst gir et par problemer da en hemmelig forlovelse blir avslørt.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Hitting Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Kamie tar med parene ut av huset for å ta et skjebnesprang. Forholdet til Spari og Shayla virker perfekt, men når lavmålet. En omgang 'knask eller knep' er artig, helt til Jamie er respektløs mot Thailah foran alle.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: We Need This Time Apart
programme.desc: Kamie kommer med sjokkerende nyheter da parene begynner neste fase av reisen mot forlovelse. Sorinns tvilsomme ble måte å redde forholdet til Lola på, kan avslutte det. Leylahs kjærlighetstriangel får henne til å føle seg ringeaktet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Can Love You Better
programme.desc: Partnerne flytter ut av huset, eksene blir igjen for å arbeide med problemene sine. En tur til Hemmelighullet tvinger partnerne til å spørre seg om de har det bedre uten eksene sine. Samura utløser en eksplosiv krangel.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg hater Sams kjæreste

programme.desc: Freddie trenger litt guttetid, så han slår seg sammen med Spencer for å dra og fekte. Freddie er et naturtalent, men ting blir innviklet når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mot den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så han først
programme.desc: Når Carly og Sam viser interesse for den samme fyren, lover de at han ikke skal komme imellom dem. Men det er vanskelig, og når de slåss om hans oppmerksomhet, blir vennskapet deres satt på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack rat
programme.desc: Carly må trå til når Spencer blir avhengig av et videospil. Sam lurer Freddie til å tro at han blir forfulgt av uhell når han nekter å sende et kjedebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: Hubert Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Lur Lewbert"-sketsj går helt galt og skader Carlys irriterende portvakt. Gjengen pleier ham inntil Freddies mor tar over. Men når kærligheten begynner å blomstre, må de sette en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Pie
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Spencer tar med Freddie til deres yndlingskonditori, finner de ut at eieren er død. Men enda verre er det at oppskriftene hans kanskje er gått tapt for alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: Jul
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å pifte opp julen med et utradisjonelt tre, kommer Spencer til å sette fyr på alle Carlys gaver. Fortvilet ønsker hun seg at hun hadde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kysset
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortelle Carly at han aldri har kysset en jente, og avslører hemmeligheten hans på netshowet. Gibby og Carly trener Spencer til utttaket for det lokale, profesjonelle fotballaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Bilbråk
programme.desc: Gjengen holder en konkurranse på iCarly, og premien er en ny bil fra en lokal forhandler. Etter at Nevel vinner, oppdager barna at forhandleren ikke visste noe om konkurransen eller bilen de skulle ha donert bort som premie.

programme.title: iCarly: Fred
programme.desc: Freddie sier offentlig at han ikke er fan av internettsensasjonen Fred, noe som får Fred til å meddele at han skal slutte å legge ut filmer for alltid. Fansen blir rasende fordi Freddie har forårsaket slutten på de populære filmene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dobbelt opp

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 1

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler håper at Nicole vil se på ham som noe mer enn en venn. Shad viser litt følelser. Alle i huset plages av hjertesorg og sjalusi, og henvender seg til Keith i håp om at han vil klare å pønske ut en vinnende strategi.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Den siste Match Up-seremonien nærmer seg, og huset er desperat etter å sende de riktige parene inn i sannhetsbåsen og finne sammen som 11 perfekte par. Keith og Alexis presser hverandre altfor langt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: 99 Problems But I Can't Find The One

programme.sub-title: 99 Problems But I Can't Find The One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 1
programme.desc: Etter uker på leting etter kjærligheten og spill om penger møtes deltagerne fra sesong 6 igjen for å gi innsideinformasjon om de eksplosive episodene, sladre litt om dramaet bak scenen, og avsløre hva som skjedde etter at de forlot huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion Special Pt2
programme.desc: Etter uker på leting etter kjærligheten og spill om penger møtes deltagerne fra sesong 6 igjen for å gi innsideinformasjon om de eksplosive episodene, sladre litt om dramaet bak scenen, og avsløre hva som skjedde etter at de forlot huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Leap of Fate
programme.desc: 22 single gjør et skjebnesvangert sprang og flytter inn i et hus på Hawaii for å prøve å finne fram til 11 perfekte par og vinne 1 000 000 dollar. Sjalusien blomstrer når flere par raskt finner hverandre.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Flirt at Your Own Risk
programme.desc: Zak provoserer fram Brias vrede når han flørter med andre kvinner, og hele huset blir trukket med i dramaet. Tevin og Kenyas flørtende stil truer deres spirende romanse.

programme.title: Are You The One?: With Frenemies Like These...
programme.desc: Zak sjekker sine muligheter mens kvinnene slåss med hverandre om hans oppmerksomhet. Kenya og Jasmine blir offisielt fiender.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name
programme.desc: Asia blir såret når hun får vite hva venninnen og han hun er forelsket i, gjorde bak ryggen hennes. Cali og Bretts gryende romanse settes på spill av deres egne dårlige datingvaner.
programme.sub-title: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tracurricular Activities
programme.desc: Huset er i sjokk når eksene deres kommer for å oppleve litt kvalitetstid. Spenningen stiger når en av eksene truer med å splitte ett av de sterkeste parene og en annen blir aggressiv. Zak trekkes mellom Bria og Morgan.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Spilling The Tea
programme.desc: Kwasi starter et drama når hun kommenterer hva Tevin og Jasmine gjorde kvelden før. Bria er sint på Morgan og Zaks gryende forhold. Huset tar noen sjanser i valget av matchende partnere.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Cam setter spørsmålstegn ved sitt forhold til Kayla. Daniels tulling og tøysing skyver Sam bort. Huset opplever sin viktigste sannhetsbås til nå.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beast Mode
programme.desc: Det oppstår spenninger mellom Cam og Kwasi når Kwasi prøver seg på Kayla. Asia eksploderer fordi hun mener at noen i huset er uærlige. Zak må gjøre et valg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I Want You To Want Me
programme.desc: Nutsa er forelsket i Brett, men det at Brett ikke klarer å komme over Cali, får konsekvenser for alle i huset. Moe presses til å bli med i spillet. Lewis avslører sine virkelige følelser for Asia.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Want Me

programme.title: Are You The One?: Master Plan
programme.desc: Brias besatthet av Zak og Zaks flørting truer husets evne til å følge spillet. Cali lager en plan for å finne ut hvilke av de sterke parene er en perfekt match eller ikke.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time
programme.desc: På en vill fest gjør tvilsom oppførsel bestevenner til hverandres verste fiender. Tevin og Kenya gjør seg klar til å møte skjebnen. Moe presses til å øke innsatsen.
programme.sub-title: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time

programme.title: Are You The One?: Caught On Kiss Cam
programme.desc: Kwasi og Jasmines forhold settes på spill når en kjent motstander gjør et utspill overfor dem. Sterke par prøver å skape nye kontakter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This is Nuts-a
programme.desc: Brett må svare for seg når han angrer på følelsene sine overfor Nutsa. Huset er i krisetilstand når de prøver å finne ut av hvem som er de rette parene.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 17: Episode 1726

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 17: Episode 1727

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 17: Episode 1730

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 17: Episode 1731

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 17: Episode 1733
programme.desc: Juryen har tatt sin avgjørelse, og en gutt sendes ut av hotellet. Jentene får et vanskelig valg som kan avgjøre skjebnen til en av guttene. Det går hett for seg på sesongens siste Pandoras.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 17: Episode 1734

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 17: Episode 1735

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 17: Episode 1736

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 17

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 18
programme.desc: Kaoset fortsetter på hotellet og en flørt skaper sjalusidrama. En gjest får et hemmelig oppdrag.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 18
programme.desc: Det er full forvirring rundt hvem som kan stå med hvem, men en ting er sikkert – ingen vil stå med Emil. Det er mye som skal på plass før kveldens parseremoni, og klarer Kornelia det hemmelige oppdraget?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 18
programme.desc: Semifinale! Et tema hvor allianser og vennskap skal settes på prøve venter gjestene. Hvem her villig til å ofre alt for en sjanse i finaleuken, og hvem havner på faretavlen?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 18
programme.desc: Hvem kan stole på hvem? Gjestene møtes for å spille «dødelig sjakk» og vinnerne får sette en gjest i fare.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 18
programme.desc: Gjestene som er i fare må spille et skjebnesvangert brettspill hvor de selv er brikkene. Alle blir satt opp mot hverandre i håp om å komme seg ett skritt nærmere finaleuken.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Sesong 18
programme.desc: Det er duket for sesongens siste parseremoni. Svik og hardt spill har snudd opp ned på hotellet. Hvor mye er egentlig vennskap på Paradise Hotel verdt?

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 620
programme.desc: En spennende lærlingkamp som utfordrer deltakerne på samarbeid og kommunikasjon, setter de to tapende lagene på prøve. Denne gangen ender tre deltakere i kokkekamp, én må reise hjem.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 307
programme.desc: Det er serveringsdag på Camp Kulinaris. Deltakerne skal for første gang drifte en a la carte restaurant. Det skal vise seg å ikke være så lett og det oppstår ganske raskt totalt kaos på kjøkkenet.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 717
programme.desc: Ny uke betyr vanligvis ny restaurantsjef, men overraskelsen er stor når deltakerne i stedet deles inn i tre lag som skal konkurrere mot hverandre. Det tar ikke lang tid før ett lag utpeker seg.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 731
programme.desc: Finalen er kun to dager unna! For å komme dit må de fire gjenværende deltakerne gjennom to nye konkurranser, hvor matlaging under tidspress og en veldig allsidig råvare er stikkord.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 613
programme.desc: Denne ukesmenyen byr på en stor utfordring for deltakerne. Heldigvis sender Kjartan inn ekstra arbeidskraft som kommer til nytte.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 724
programme.desc: “Min mormors kjøkken” har vært ukens tema. I dag avsluttes den med en lærling- og kokkekamp som er temaet verdig.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 230
programme.desc: Det er andre dagen i finaleuken og Kjartan vil sette deltakernes smaksprøver på prøve. I dag handler det om å bruke sansene og ferdighetene sine for å samle poeng.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 515
programme.desc: Det er serveringsdag på Camp Kulinaris. Etter en variert menysmaking i går har deltakerne mye å bevise. Klarer restaurantsjefen å snu skuta?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 429
programme.desc: Det er første dag i finaleuka på Camp Kulinaris. Mia, Terje, Fetisha Ole og Hasse skal I dag gjennom to konkurranser. Hvor allerede den første konkurransen blir viktig inn mot morgendagen.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 325
programme.desc: Det er siste uke før finaleuka på Camp Kulinaris. Kjartan annonserer en vri på denne uka som overrasker alle, og en av deltakerne sliter med motivasjonen og holder seg unna kjøkkenet.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 232
programme.desc: Det er finale på Camp kulinaris og Kjartan utsetter dem for den vanskeligste prøvelsen noensinne. To deltakere møtes til finalen og det blir et sammenbrudd på kjøkkenet før dommerne får servert maten.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 727
programme.desc: To billetter til finaleuken skal gis ut når årets siste servering avholdes på Camp kulinaris. Klarer deltakerne å gjøre årets rester om til en fine dining-servering som Kjartan finner bra nok?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 224
programme.desc: I dag må restaurantsjefen velge en lærling som må forsvare plassen sin på Camp Kulinaris. Det blir en jevn og dramatisk lærlingkamp der to deltakere møtes til sudden death.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 328
programme.desc: Det er konkurransedag på Camp Kulinaris. I går vant Aurora serveringen og får med seg en fordel inn i dagens lærlingkamp. Det blir en annerledes kokkekamp med tre deltakere som må kjempe mot hverandre

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 315
programme.desc: Det er serveringsdag på Camp Kulinaris. Rødt og blått lag serverer streetfood fra hver sin foodtruck i Kragerø sentrum. Det blir en jevn kamp og til slutt er det en rett som avgjør det hele.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 720
programme.desc: To lag må konkurrere mot hverandre i kampen om å unngå kokkekamp. Laget som er best til å holde masken vil ha et godt utgangspunkt i dagens lærlingkamp.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 605
programme.desc: Det er ny uke på Camp Kulinaris og deltakerne har allerede blitt en sammensveiset gjeng som trives godt i hverandres selskap. Alle er spente på hvem ukens restaurantsjef blir.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 503

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 203

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 510
programme.desc: Konkurransen tilspisser seg mellom rødt og blått lag. Ukas meny blir endelig avslørt, men ikke alle er like fornøyde med råvarene.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1312

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1107

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Politiker Per Sandberg og hans nye flamme, Bahareh Letnes, lander på Granca for å nyte livet i Puerto Rico. Bjørge aka Løkmannen og kona Tove gjør comeback på Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1025

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 901
programme.desc: Sommeren sparkes i gang, og det er tid for å møte reiselystne nordmenn som gleder seg til å kjenne på sydenvarmen igjen; Hilde bobler over av entusiasme fordi hun endelig skal tilbake på charterferie.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 907
programme.desc: Christian er ikke spesielt fornøyd med å dele hotellrom med moren, og jobber hardt for å få et eget rom med sjøutsikt.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1028
programme.desc: Damene i gjengen fra Buskerud arrangerer utdrikningslag for Tove som skal gifte seg med Rune i morgen. Familien Gude bruker dagen på shopping og strandkos. Radio Kvinesdal er på karneval.

programme.title: Charterfeber After Beach: Episode 101

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1108

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1111

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1123

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 913

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1101
